hard_reason_reverted:
QUOTA HARD STOP ({which} at {pct}%, threshold {thr}%). The in-progress item "{item}" was reverted via git stash ({stash_status}). All quota windows reset by: {resets_at}.

Write a brief status note to `.agy-quota/progress.md` if needed, do NOT start or continue any work, and end your turn immediately. The external runner (`agy-run`) will resume this conversation by ID after the quota resets.
hard_reason_revert_skipped_dirty:
QUOTA HARD STOP ({which} at {pct}%, threshold {thr}%). Auto-revert was skipped because the working tree was already dirty when "{item}" started (or no new changes existed to stash). Nothing was reverted.

Update `.agy-quota/progress.md` with the current state of "{item}", do NOT run any other tools, and end your turn immediately. Resets at: {resets_at}.
hard_reason_no_revert_disabled: QUOTA HARD STOP ({which} at {pct}%, threshold {thr}%). Item in progress: "{item}". Automatic git stash revert is disabled (default). Update `.agy-quota/progress.md` with the exact state of "{item}", do NOT start any new work, and end your turn immediately. Resets at: {resets_at}.
hard_reason_no_revert_no_git: QUOTA HARD STOP ({which} at {pct}%, threshold {thr}%). Item in progress: "{item}". Not a git repository, so automatic revert is unavailable. Update `.agy-quota/progress.md` and end your turn immediately. Resets at: {resets_at}.
hard_reason_no_item: QUOTA HARD STOP ({which} at {pct}%, threshold {thr}%). No tracked item was marked in_progress. Update `.agy-quota/progress.md` with your current checkpoint and end your turn immediately. Resets at: {resets_at}.
hard_user_msg_reverted: ⛔ [agy-quota-guard] HARD STOP — {which} {pct}%. Reverted "{item}" via git stash. Waiting for reset at {resets_at}.
hard_user_msg_not_reverted: ⛔ [agy-quota-guard] HARD STOP — {which} {pct}%. Auto-revert did not run (disabled, dirty baseline, or no changes); stopping turn. Resets at {resets_at}.
soft_reason:
QUOTA SOFT STOP ({which} at {pct}%, threshold {thr}%). Do NOT start the next task.

1. Update `.agy-quota/progress.md` now: mark completed items, list remaining items, and record the exact next step.
2. Do not invoke any tools other than updating `.agy-quota/progress.md`.
3. End your turn immediately after saving `.agy-quota/progress.md`.

All triggered quota windows reset by: {resets_at}. `agy-run` will resume this conversation by ID after reset.
soft_user_msg: ⏸️ [agy-quota-guard] SOFT STOP — {which} {pct}% (threshold {thr}%). Saving checkpoint to .agy-quota/progress.md. Resets at {resets_at}.
deny_tool_after_stop: Blocked by agy-quota-guard ({mode} quota stop active; {which} at {pct}%, resets at {resets_at}). Only updating `.agy-quota/progress.md` is permitted before ending the turn.
missing_checkpoint_note:
## ⚠️ Quota stop terminated without model checkpoint
- Time: {time}
- Mode: {mode} ({which} at {pct}%)
- Note: The turn ended before `.agy-quota/progress.md` was updated by the model. Inspect `git status` and `git diff` on resume before continuing.
stash_created: stash created, recoverable via `git stash list`
stash_clean: working tree clean or unchanged, no stash created
append_prompt:
---
[agy-quota-guard instructions]
1. Break multi-step work into discrete tasks using `task_boundary` (or `TodoWrite` / `TaskCreate` / `TaskUpdate`) and keep `.agy-quota/progress.md` updated at each checkpoint.
2. Keep at most ONE item `in_progress` at a time.
3. If `agy-quota-guard` injects a SOFT or HARD quota stop message or denies a tool call, immediately write your current checkpoint to `.agy-quota/progress.md` and end your turn.
4. When the ENTIRE user task is completely finished, write `AGY_QUOTA_DONE` at the very beginning of a new line in `.agy-quota/progress.md`.
resume_soft: Quota has reset. Read `.agy-quota/progress.md` and `.agy-quota/todos_state.json`, verify `git status`, and continue from the next pending item. Remember to write `AGY_QUOTA_DONE` at the start of a line in `.agy-quota/progress.md` when all tasks are complete.
resume_hard_reverted: Quota has reset after a HARD stop. The previously in-progress item was reverted via `git stash` and reset to `pending`. Read `.agy-quota/progress.md` and `.agy-quota/todos_state.json`, verify `git status`, and redo that item from scratch. Write `AGY_QUOTA_DONE` in `.agy-quota/progress.md` when everything is complete.
resume_hard_unreverted: Quota has reset after a HARD stop where automatic revert did not run. Read `.agy-quota/progress.md` and `.agy-quota/todos_state.json`, inspect `git status` and `git diff` carefully to check for partial edits, complete or clean up the interrupted item, and continue. Write `AGY_QUOTA_DONE` in `.agy-quota/progress.md` when everything is complete.
continue_incomplete: Continue the remaining work recorded in `.agy-quota/progress.md`. When the entire task is finished, write `AGY_QUOTA_DONE` at the start of a line in `.agy-quota/progress.md`.
err_missing_conversation_id: [agy-quota-guard] ERROR: Cannot resume without a captured conversation ID (-c/--continue fallback is disabled for safety).
notify_failed: Aborted after {retries} consecutive failures (last exit code {rc}).
notify_no_conversation_id: ERROR: no conversation ID was captured; refusing unsafe resume.
notify_incomplete: Stopped: agy exited without AGY_QUOTA_DONE and the continuation limit was reached; saved progress is available.
chat_reset: 🔋 Quota reset ({label} now {pct}%) — resuming the chat automatically.
chat_reset_nopct: 🔋 Quota reset — resuming the chat automatically.
chat_working: ▶️ Antigravity is working again from where it stopped.
chat_turn_done: ✅ Antigravity finished the resumed turn — check the chat for the result.
chat_schedule_failed: ⚠️ Auto-resume could not be scheduled — type 'continue' in the chat after the reset ({time}).
